explanation: Controller prioritizes pole upright (theta ~-0.08 rad, margin ~0.72 at failure) with small force ~0.8N well below 50.5N limit, but fails to arrest steady negative cart drift from initial v=-0.32 m/s. Cart moves monotonically negative and exits track at x=-2.41. Removing initial velocity eliminates failure, showing cause is insufficient cart-position correction, not saturation or pole instability.
